ModMetaData.name: Prisoner Interaction Timer
ModMetaData.author: CoolNether123
ModMetaData.description:
Shows when a warden can next interact with a prisoner and what is holding them up.
- Live interaction cooldown and next eligible time - Which interaction modes are currently active - Current blockers, such as sleep, incapacity, or no eligible warden - Optional notifications when a prisoner becomes ready for a watched mode - Reads state only; never changes cooldowns or assigns wardens
Requires Harmony and SpineLib.
